description: D14 modular-S-transform: theta converges only on the bar image q0^{-1} (Im tau > 0); the Descartes/color elliptic curve E_q is NOT the Hecke modular torus (period-nome mismatch ~200-480x). Formalize-first probe for the Jacobi-triple-product/theta avenue (conj:modular-s-transform-q-q-tilde).

findings.A_bar_side_convergence: q0 > 1 -> Im(tau) < 0 -> theta diverges; q0^{-1} < 1 -> Im(tau) > 0 -> theta converges. The D14 premise 'tau in H' forces the q0^{-1} branch.
findings.B_nome_conflation_trap: E_q period nome ~ 0.002-0.004 (deep in fundamental domain, tau ~ i) vs Hecke modular nome q0^{-1} ~ 0.90 (near cusp, tau ~ 0.0166 i). Distinct elliptic structures; do not identify.
